dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast white wing bar clearly visible on the greater coverts, appearing as a thick, sharp horizontal band against dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence; sharp, distinct white margins are visible along the edges of the folded primary and secondary flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A high-contrast, roughly rectangular white patch is present on the central nape, bordered by black and olive plumage.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct boundary between the black crown and the olive-green mantle, interrupted by the white nape patch.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, high-contrast white auricular patch is visible on the side of the head, bordered by black plumage.
